title: Period and Frequency in Oscillations
lead: When you pluck a guitar string, each vibration takes the same time as the one before it. This section names that time the period, counts the vibrations in each second to define the frequency, and shows that each of the two is the reciprocal of the other.
objectives: Observe the vibrations of a guitar string.
summary_html:
• Periodic motion is a repetitious oscillation.
  • The time for one oscillation is the period $\kT$.
  • The number of oscillations per unit time is the frequency $\kf$.
  • These quantities are related by $\kf = \frac{1}{\kT}.$
exercise_notes: Bloom levels, concept tags and hints are AI-generated. Answers come from the book’s answer key; every exercise in this section is keyed. Numeric answers accept 2% tolerance.

exercises.prompt: Identify an event in your life (such as receiving a paycheck) that occurs regularly. Identify both the period and frequency of this event.

answer.solution: I visit my parents for dinner every other Sunday. The frequency of my visits is 26 per calendar year. The period is two weeks.

exercises.prompt: A mass attached to a spring oscillates and completes 50 full cycles in 30 s. What is the time period and frequency of this system?

parts.hint: Frequency is the number of cycles divided by the time they take.
The period is the time for one cycle, or the reciprocal of the frequency.

answer.solution: The frequency is given by $\kf = \frac{1}{\kT} = \frac{50\ \text{cycles}}{30\ \text{s}} = 1.66\ \text{Hz}$. Time period is: $\kT = \frac{1}{\kf} = \frac{1}{1.66} = 0.6\ \text{s}$

exercises.prompt: What is the period of $60.0\ \text{Hz}$ electrical power?

answer.hint: The period is the reciprocal of the frequency. Give the answer in milliseconds.

exercises.prompt: If your heart rate is 150 beats per minute during strenuous exercise, what is the time per beat in units of seconds?

answer.hint: Find the number of beats in each second first. The time per beat is the reciprocal of that.

exercises.prompt: Find the frequency of a tuning fork that takes $2.50 \times 10^{-3}\ \text{s}$ to complete one oscillation.

answer.hint: The time for one oscillation is the period, and the frequency is its reciprocal.

exercises.prompt: A stroboscope is set to flash every $8.00 \times 10^{-5}\ \text{s}$. What is the frequency of the flashes?

answer.hint: The time between flashes is the period. Frequency is the number of flashes in each second.

exercises.prompt: A tire has a tread pattern with a crevice every 2.00 cm. Each crevice makes a single vibration as the tire moves. What is the frequency of these vibrations if the car moves at 30.0 m/s?

answer.hint: In one second the car moves 30.0 m. Count how many 2.00 cm crevices pass in that distance.

exercises.prompt: Each piston of an engine makes a sharp sound every other revolution of the engine. (a) How fast is a race car going if its eight-cylinder engine emits a sound of frequency 750 Hz, given that the engine makes 2000 revolutions per kilometer? (b) At how many revolutions per minute is the engine rotating?

parts.hint: Eight pistons, each sounding every other revolution, give four sounds per revolution. Find the revolutions per second, then use the revolutions per kilometer.
Multiply the revolutions per second by 60.
